This bean plot is very small, so I will keep cash costs low and do most things with family labor. I have seen beans do well here without buying chemical fertilizer, and for a plot this size even a small fertilizer purchase can still feel expensive. I will use better seed if I can get it from the agro-dealer or another farmer, and I will put some manure on the plot because the land is ours and I want to keep it productive.
